newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - ESS '97 estimate cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ESS '97 estimate cut.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said it cut its 1997 earnings estimate for ESS Technology Inc to $1.75/shr from $1.85/shr reflecting weaker-than-expected gross margins in the second quarter ending in June.
-- The investment firm maintained a revenue estimate of $370 million for 1997 and a strong buy rating on the stock based on a strong outlook for the second half of 1997.

-- On Wednesday, ESS reported a first quarter profit of $0.43 a share versus a loss of $0.55 a share, but it said it forecast downward pressure on second quarter margins. Shares of ESS were off 8-5/64 to 13-63/64 at midday on Thursday.
